body: Brought Today, the Calendar, the day modal and the note view/edit modal to parity with the Claude Design mock-up, end to end: spec, build, gate, ship, owner check. The owner closed it with "All changes complete."U+000AU+000ASpec: interphase prototype pathway. docs/specs/today-calendar-day-modal-parity.md (403 lines, 19 sections), 9 binding decisions, 16 assumptions, 1 open question (should view mode's Earlier and Later cross into neighbouring days; left open as purely additive). The owner chose the pager calendar model, a long-press pill on touch, confirmations before delete and before saving an edit, and past-days-plus-today tap rules. The owner set the governing rule: where the design is silent, keep the live core logic and match the design's look. A spec-reviewer pass caught four build-changing defects: the underline test would have passed on broken code because the existing harness supplied a Material; a "never resizes" claim edit mode cannot meet; a pill whose top 11 points were dead to taps; an unspecified view-mode scrim tap.U+000AU+000ABuild: mitosis ran 13 Steps across 5 held MSPs. The first plan fused four Steps into one serial Lane, because entry_cards.dart sat in two write-sets; the fix gave that file to the cleanup Step alone. 12 of 13 Steps landed, 73 of 73 acceptance tests pass, 0 inert. remove-entry-card correctly refused on a missing barrel file and was done by hand.U+000AU+000AFour defects the workers flagged outside their write-sets were fixed on the branches, each red before green: short-note text taps swallowed by SelectionArea; viewer players hardcoded, which had cost the moved video tests their assertions; the voice placeholder overflowing at doubled text and in narrow cards; two day-modal tests red on the modal branch alone. Benchmark 5 was retargeted to compact cards, and its doc row now says an earlier result is not comparable.U+000AU+000AMistake: git stash in a scratch worktree landed on the owner's repo-wide stash list; popped at once, the owner's stashes untouched.U+000AU+000AShipped: PRs 164 to 168, merged; full gate on merged main 9567b61: analyze clean, 1980 tests, 39 goldens. Owner confirmed on macOS and reported one mismatch: the Edit icon was a port of the design's pencil capture icon, not its edit icon. PR 169 fixed the one path, with two new goldens that fail on the old glyph by 11 and 24 percent; merged, main at 042c164.U+000AU+000ACleanup: the five scratch worktrees and 19 merged local branches are deleted; the owner's 49 worktrees and their branches are untouched.U+000AU+000ARisks: 1 added (the local gate never runs integration_test), 4 retired as over, 1 kept (the compact card's text-scaler workaround for NoteBody's missing style parameter).
